sources.title: Super(ficial)-alignment: Strong Models May Deceive Weak Models in Weak-to-Strong Generalization — quoted full-text passages (arXiv 2406.11431v3 PDF)

state_meaning: AI-drafted candidate; no person has reviewed it.
text: The authors define weak-to-strong deception as occurring when cases in the Strong-Known and Weak-Unknown area that the strong model would generalize well without the conflict become misaligned when conflicting targets are present. The Deception Score (DS) is the fraction of conflict-tax cases (correct under the no-conflict reference model but wrong under the conflict-aligned model) that fall within Strong-Known intersect Weak-Unknown, out of all such cases.
title: Deception Score: share of conflict tax in strong-known, weak-unknown cases
